During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a '''barren [[Mountain/Legends|rocky]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]''' was the site of the [[Battle of unidentified planet (bubble wort projectors)|battle]] between [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], [[Voolvif Monn]], [[Agen Kolar/Legends|Agen Kolar]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and several [[LM-432 crab droid/Legends|LM-432 crab droids]].<ref name="CW22" />
